name: Leather Running Sneakers
description: Premium leather sneakers perfect for running and casual wear. Lightweight sole with excellent grip.
longDescription: Crafted from top-grain genuine leather, these running sneakers combine style and performance. The cushioned insole provides all-day comfort while the rubber outsole delivers excellent traction on any surface. Available in multiple sizes to suit every foot.

name: Women's Block Heel Boots
description: Elegant block heel ankle boots with a modern cut. Perfect for office and evening outings.
longDescription: These sophisticated block heel boots are designed for the modern Nepali woman. Featuring a stable 7cm block heel, soft faux-suede exterior, and side zipper closure, they pair beautifully with everything from office trousers to evening dresses.

name: Traditional Nepali Sandals
description: Handcrafted sandals inspired by traditional Nepali artisanship. Comfortable and stylish.
longDescription: Made by skilled artisans in Bhaktapur, these handcrafted sandals feature intricate hand-stitching on genuine buffalo leather. Lightweight and breathable, they are ideal for the warm months and cultural events.

name: Men's Premium Casual Shirt
description: Relaxed-fit casual shirt in 100% cotton. Available in five colours, ideal for everyday wear.
longDescription: Our best-selling casual shirt is crafted from 100% breathable cotton, pre-washed to prevent shrinking. The relaxed fit suits all body types, and the classic collar makes it easy to dress up or down. Machine washable.

name: Women's Floral Kurta Set
description: Beautifully embroidered floral kurta with matching palazzo pants. Ideal for festivals and occasions.
longDescription: This exquisite kurta set features delicate floral embroidery on premium georgette fabric. The matching palazzo pants complete the ensemble perfectly. Whether for Dashain, Tihar, or a casual evening out, this set captures the essence of Nepali femininity.

name: Classic Denim Jacket
description: Timeless unisex denim jacket with a distressed wash. A wardrobe essential for all seasons.
longDescription: This classic denim jacket in a flattering medium wash is the ultimate layering piece. Reinforced stitching, brass-toned buttons, and two chest pockets give it a sturdy, authentic feel. Suits both men and women and looks great over a kurta or a casual tee.

name: Genuine Leather Tote Bag
description: Spacious tote bag in genuine tan leather. Holds everything you need with everyday elegance.
longDescription: This roomy tote is handcrafted from full-grain vegetable-tanned leather that develops a beautiful patina over time. It features a central zip compartment, interior pockets, and sturdy double handles. A lifetime companion for work or the weekend.

name: Urban Backpack
description: 25L anti-theft backpack with USB charging port. Perfect for students and professionals.
longDescription: The Urban Backpack combines smart design with everyday practicality. The hidden anti-theft pocket sits against your back, the USB port charges your phone on the go, and the padded laptop sleeve fits up to 15.6 inches. Built from water-resistant 900D polyester.

name: Crossbody Mini Bag
description: Compact vegan-leather crossbody bag with adjustable strap. Fits phone, cards, and keys.
longDescription: This chic mini crossbody bag is crafted from cruelty-free vegan leather with a gold-tone chain and adjustable nylon strap. It fits a smartphone, cards, and keys — perfect for a night out or a quick grocery run.

name: Gold Plated Necklace Set
description: 18K gold-plated layered necklace set with a pendant. Comes in a premium gift box.
longDescription: This elegant layered necklace set features 18K gold plating over brass, ensuring long-lasting shine. It includes two complementary chains — a delicate 16" and a pendant 18" — that can be worn together or separately. Tarnish-resistant and nickel-free.

name: Silver Chandelier Earrings
description: 925 sterling silver chandelier earrings with filigree detail. Lightweight and elegant.
longDescription: These stunning chandelier earrings are made from 925 sterling silver with intricate filigree work inspired by traditional Nepali jewellery. Lightweight enough for all-day wear, they catch the light beautifully at parties and cultural events.

name: Traditional Bangles Pack (Set of 12)
description: Colorful lacquer bangles inspired by traditional Nepali designs. Set of 12, one size fits most.
longDescription: Celebrate Nepali tradition with this vibrant set of 12 lacquer bangles featuring hand-painted floral and geometric motifs. Worn during festivals like Teej and Dashain, these bangles add colour to any outfit. One-size-fits-most design.

name: Minimalist Leather Watch
description: Ultra-thin minimalist watch with a genuine leather strap and Japanese quartz movement.
longDescription: Less is more with this ultra-slim minimalist timepiece. The 38mm matte dial sits on a genuine Italian leather strap, powered by a precise Japanese quartz movement. Water-resistant to 30m and scratch-resistant mineral glass make it a reliable daily companion.

name: Sports Chronograph Watch
description: Multi-function chronograph with 100m water resistance. Built for active lifestyles.
longDescription: Engineered for adventure, this sports chronograph features a 45mm stainless steel case, tachymeter bezel, and luminous hands. With 100m water resistance and a silicone strap, it is ready for hiking, swimming, and anything in between.

name: Women's Rose Gold Watch
description: Elegant women's watch with a rose gold case, crystal accents, and mesh bracelet.
longDescription: This feminine rose gold watch features a 32mm case adorned with CZ crystal accents on the bezel, a clean white dial, and a stainless-steel mesh bracelet. A perfect gift for mothers, sisters, and partners. Packaged in a premium gift box.

name: Classic Aviator Sunglasses
description: Timeless aviator frames with UV400 polarized lenses. Suitable for all face shapes.
longDescription: The aviator never goes out of style. These classic frames feature a lightweight stainless-steel construction, UV400 polarized lenses for eye protection in Nepal's high-altitude sun, and adjustable nose pads for a comfortable, custom fit.

name: Cat Eye Fashion Sunglasses
description: Retro-inspired cat-eye frames with gradient tinted lenses. A bold fashion statement.
longDescription: Channel vintage glamour with these oversized cat-eye sunglasses. The thick acetate frame comes in black-gold, tortoise, or pearl-white, with gradient tinted lenses that offer UV400 protection. A must-have for every fashion lover.

name: Polarized Sport Sunglasses
description: Wrap-around sport frames with polarized TR90 lenses. Built for outdoor adventures.
longDescription: Designed for Nepal's diverse outdoor terrain, these sport sunglasses feature a lightweight TR90 nylon frame with rubber grips at the temples and nose bridge to stay secure during trekking or cycling. Polarized lenses eliminate glare on snow, water, and roads.
